scope: All executed guest BL/BLX calls in ARM and Thumb, compiled and interpreted, including game and ROM/OS code on the emulation worker. No CPU-time or complete-game-playthrough claim.

limitations: Counters perturb code layout and timing. These are diagnostic call distributions, not uninstrumented performance measurements.
Each capture starts a new game; windows overlap across independent launches and are not disjoint pieces of one playthrough.
Game scenes and polling-loop counts vary; pooled percentages describe these observed calls. Per-window results are retained.
Ordinary dispatch includes interpreter calls. Prefix/entry-only fusion still reaches ordinary dispatch later. SVC instructions, returns and tail branches are not additional BL/BLX calls.
Region entries/returns include calls, returns, syscalls, loop/region exits and other control flow, and cannot be used as a guest-call denominator.
Internal branches already contained in one translated region are not counted as separate fusion events.
